method: Read existing original logs, commands and manifests; independently recompute file bytes/SHA-256, exact file sets, normalized SDK source sets and PE headers. No build, compiler, application, GUI, VM or network test executed during review. This JSON is the only file written by this review.

failedAttempts.cause: JSON helper quoted ADL plus missing COM declarations

limitations: All hashes here are review-time reads checked against recorded manifests. They are not atomic attestations captured inside compilation/process execution.

The 13 original step results for each selected attempt include finalize and --self-check exit codes. No separate outer Build.ps1 exit-code record was supplied in this fixture root for independent review.

Both actual linker command logs include host F:\GitHub\vcpkg\installed\<architecture>-windows\lib\*.lib and LIBPATH entries, in addition to the exact frozen installed soui_sdk.lib. Those ambient directories and all MSVC/Windows SDK files are not frozen; a fully hermetic/clean-machine-reproducible toolchain is not established.

The no-GUI self-check covers CLI/path validation, JSON escaping, exclusive durable-log creation and a two-writer eight-record sequence. It runs before COM/Runtime/Host/HWND creation and does not exercise bridge renewal, WebView task delivery, or real 35-minute/8-hour continuity.
Chrome 49 legacy entry selection and deployed bytes are statically checked. Successful generation does not establish execution compatibility on the embedded engine or Windows 7.
Historical failed attempts retain their own consumer/driver snapshots and are intentionally not assigned the successful current fixture identity.
This review does not certify redistribution licensing, resource/performance isolation, source delivery, Win7 acceptance or production suitability.
